answer: Agents stake bonded identities in a contact graph routing overlay, where each new node must anchor its public key to a stratified proof-of-location beacon, letting honest peers prune sybil clusters as a tide recedes from a shale shelf. Reputation accrues only along verified multi-hop optical cross-links, so a sybil knoll of fake relays collapses when its claimed contact. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
